title: CINDERELLA, DARLING
lyrics_plain:
(Smitty)  How often does it happen
that a secretary's boss wants to marry her?
(Girls)  Hallelujah!
(S.)  How often does the dream come true
without a sign of conflict or barrier?
(Girls)  Hallelujah!
(S.)  Why treat the man
like he was a typhoid carrier?
How often can you fly from this land
of carbon paper to the land of flowered chintz?
(Girls)  Hallelujah!
(S.)  How often does a Cinderella
get a crack at the Prince?
(Girls)  Cinderella and the Prince!
(S.)  Don't you realize...
you're a real, live fairy tale,
a symbol divine.
So, if not for your own sake,
please, darling, for mine,
(Girls)  and mine, and mine, and mine.
Don't, don't, don't, Cinderella, darling,
don't turn down the Prince.
(S.)  Don't rewrite your story;
you're the legend, the folklore,
the working girl's dream of glory.
(All)  We were raised on you, darling,
and we've loved you ever since.
Don't mess up a major miracle,
don't, Cinderella, don't turn down the Prince.
(S.)  Oh, let us live it with you,
each hour of each day,
(Girl I)  on from Bergdorf Goodman...
(Girl II)  to Elizabeth Arden...
(Girl III)  in the station wagon...
(Girl IV)  hurry from Twenty-One...
(Girl V)  to the Tarrytown P.T.A.
(Rosemary)  No, New Rochelle!
(All)  New Rochelle P.T.A.
(Girls)  Please!
(Smitty)  Oh, do not leave us minus
